execution.implementation: retained E-GEOD-52778 study metadata with deterministic treatment and cell-line counts plus a genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation

observations: E-GEOD-52778 describes human airway smooth-muscle RNA-seq in response to asthma medications.
The study record reports 16 samples and 16 sequencing assays.
Four treatment groups and four cell lines each contribute four samples.
The Rosalind launcher returned ready=true and did not execute a scientific job.
interpretation: The retained study-level metadata support treatment-group planning, but they do not support a paired or donor-aware model until the SDRF sample-to-donor mapping has been extracted and verified.
limitations: Reads were not downloaded and differential expression was not run.
Sample pairing and donor covariates require SDRF inspection before modeling.
The combined-treatment group must remain separate from dexamethasone alone.

provenance.note: Exact public accessions and query parameters are retained in outputs/provenance.json; outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json records the genuine launcher call and states that no scientific job executed.

reproduction: Repeat the E-GEOD-52778 BioStudies request recorded in outputs/query-verification.json.
Run python scripts/build_case.py and compare the treatment and cell-line counts with the retained study record.
Do not describe the design as paired or donor-aware until the SDRF sample-to-donor mapping has been extracted and verified.
